# Jeremiah 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying:

**2** "You-shall-not take for-yourself a-wife, and-sons and-daughters shall-not-be to-you in-this place."

**3** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**4** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**5** For thus says YHWH: "Do-not-enter a-house-of mourning, and-do-not-go to-lament and-do-not-grieve for-them, for I-have-withdrawn My-peace from this people," declares YHWH, "the-lovingkindness and-the-compassion."

**6** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**7** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**8** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**9** For thus says YHWH-of hosts, God-of Israel: "Behold-Me causing-to-cease from this place before-your-eyes and-in-your-days [the]-voice-of joy and-[the]-voice-of gladness, [the]-voice-of [the]-bridegroom and-[the]-voice-of [the]-bride."

**10** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**11** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**12** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**13** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**14** "Therefore behold, days are-coming," declares YHWH, "and-it-will-not be-said again, 'As-YHWH-lives who-brought-up the-sons-of Israel from-[the]-land-of Egypt,'

**15** But, 'As-YHWH-lives who-brought-up the-sons-of Israel from-[the]-land-of [the]-north and-from-all the-lands where He-had-driven-them,' and-I-will-bring-them-back to their-land which I-gave to-their-fathers."

**16** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**17** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**18** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**19** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**20** And-YHWH declared to-Jeremiah the-signs-of judgment — no-marriage, no-mourning, no-feasting in-the-land.

**21** "Therefore behold-Me causing-them-to-know this-time; I-will-cause-them-to-know My-hand and-My-might, and-they-will-know that My-name [is] YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **16:1**: Opening formula for the signs of coming disaster oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **16:10**: Central imagery of forbidden mourning — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **16:21**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
